annotations.title: Stock, ETF or coin key facts

description: Dated key facts and a plain-English chart read for one ticker Portfolio Terminal covers (390 US stocks, 30 ETFs, 17 cryptocurrencies and 4 commodity futures): price and one-year change, 52-week range, distance from the 200-day average, 30-day volatility with a risk rating, P/E and dividend yield, all-time high and "lowest since", ten years against the S&P 500 (SPY), support and resistance levels, which tracked ETFs and famous investors (13F) hold it, and related research. Use it for "how is NVDA doing", "is TSLA near its high", "what does the AAPL chart say".

ticker.description: The ticker as listed in the US ("NVDA", "VOO", "BRK.B"), a coin ("BTC" or "BTC-USD") or a future ("GC=F" for gold).
